title: The Outlast Trials joins Xbox Game Pass on December 1 🎮
subject: gamepass
description:
Which one are you downloading first? 👇

Xbox revealed the second November 2026 wave of Game Pass: High on Life 2 and Call of the Elder Gods on November 18, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 on November 24, and The Outlast Trials plus Hela: of Mice & Magic on December 1. Eight games leave on November 30.

Sources: Xbox Wire (Nov 17, 2026), GameSpot
Game footage © Red Barrels.

scenes.text: The Outlast Trials joins Xbox Game Pass on December 1.
Xbox Wire confirmed it on November 17 for Ultimate, Premium and PC Game Pass subscribers.
High on Life 2 and Call of the Elder Gods arrive on November 18.
Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 follows on November 24, and Hela: of Mice & Magic launches day one on December 1.
Eight games leave on November 30, including Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden, Aliens: Dark Descent and Moving Out 2.
